purpose: Speed up the newly larger-basis research backend without changing final physical accuracy
execution: Static CUDA graphs, shifted Hamiltonians, preallocated cached operator images, incremental projected matrix
assessment: Compare final FP64 energy/state and cold/warm solve time to the saved matched full-FP64 larger-basis runs. No repeated reference generation, parameter/seed sweeps or frontier execution.
limitations: Numerical backend, not a trained model
GPU times do not establish CPU or A100 target performance
